7084-7893-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf creature token
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

7084-7892-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1170-1976-2981-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1976-2981-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

824-2728-4153-5256.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-4153-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-4153-5256.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2021-2060-7704-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

413-2946-3220-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-2946-3220-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Golgari Germination and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

215-1902-5434.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-5434.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

796-1618-2440-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher
796-1618-2440-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
796-1618-2440-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

240-2079-2921-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

643-3000-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog by paying {G}{U}
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Maskwood Nexus, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
Repeat step 3.
643-3000-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

874-5660-6701.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-5660-6701.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Delif's Cone ability.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1308-2919-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-2919-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

803-2034-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
803-2034-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

4871-7060-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

1286-3967-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-3967-5972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3139-4050-5544-6822.description:
Cast Forsaken Miner by paying {B}.
When Forsaken Miner enters, The Great Henge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
Resolve the The Great Henge trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Lyla triggers.

2034-4112-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

719-5365-5641-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability and Basking Broodscale trigger, creating a Clue token and a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
719-5365-5641-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Basking Broodscale for infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens

957-2707-4183-6504.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Time Stretch onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Time Stretch from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each other turn.

862-5220-5256-5683.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crimson Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

92-3392-6024.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}.
Cast Toxic Deluge by paying {2}{B}, and paying an amount of life equal to your life total minus 1.
Holding priority, activate Children of Korlis by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life you've lost this turn.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

2034-5189-5532.easyPrerequisites: "Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
2034-5189-5532.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-5189-5532.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Ghave.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
2034-5189-5532.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Ghave, you may target any other creature with Battle of Hoover Dam's trigger instead. You may also forego sacrificing the Saprolings.

2-4067-5922.notablePrerequisites: Helga does not have summoning sickness and has power 4 or greater.
2-4067-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least {4} that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or creature spells with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Helga triggers, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Helga.
Repeat.
2-4067-5922.notes: If you have enough leftover mana to cast the creature, you can instead substitute untapping another permanent instead of Helga.

1887-4094-4636-5770.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight {E}.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1887-4094-4636-5770.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating two 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat from step 2.

2051-2546-4298-4566.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
2051-2546-4298-4566.description:
Activate Barren Moor's cycling ability by paying {B} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Barren Moor ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Borborygmos Enraged by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Borborygmos Enraged ability, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Barren Moor and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

513-2454-2609-4668.notablePrerequisites:
the Warped Eclipse.
Your opponents have drawn at least three cards this turn.
513-2454-2609-4668.description:
Activate Chromatic Lantern by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {W}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Chromatic Lantern to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Cast Chromatic Lantern by paying {0}.
Repeat.

814-1651-2751-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Soldiers.
Myrel does not have summoning sickness.
814-1651-2751-4659.description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Myrel's ability.
Resolve the copy of Myrel's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Soldiers, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2190-2390-3276-5299.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to place a counter on a permanent or player.
2190-2390-3276-5299.description:
Place a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Vraska triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on All Will Be One.
Repeat from step 2.

2009-3858.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten power worth of creatures excluding Mossbridge Troll.
2009-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Activate Mossbridge Troll by tapping creatures you control with a total power of ten or greater, giving Mossbridge Troll +20/+20.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, winning the game.

225-433-539-5233.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Llanowar Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

1476-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1476-3259.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Legion Warboss triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3249-3652-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
